name: gas_pipe_insulated_pressure_drop
title: Gas pipe pressure drop and heat gain with insulation and fittings (R717)
summary: Insulated R717 gas line of the Laborelec 2002 toolkit: heat gain from ambient air (internal Nusselt correlation, insulation cylinder, external convection, dew point), Colebrook-White friction drop (built-in Colebrook), fitting K-factor drops from a nearest-diameter table and an equivalent nozzle area identified from the total pressure drop. A liquid-line variant (R134a, TM-0309) is shipped as a runnable variant.

authors: Felipe Trebilcock (ULiege Thermodynamics Lab, Dec 2002, for Laborelec)
origin.course: Laborelec refrigeration-line sizing toolkit (ULiege Thermodynamics Laboratory)

verification.summary: Gas native file vs the EES stored solution (52 variables): 48 common, 44 within 6.2e-4; the 4 others are an enthalpy reference offset (h_i/SP[2]), stale Pr and cp-derived DELTAT_total. Liquid-line variant (TM-0309, R134a) vs its stored solution: 48 common, 8 differ at 1e-3 (enthalpy offset, f 2.8e-3, Dp 2.0e-3).
verification.reference: Solution stored in Gas_Pipe_Pressure_Drop.EES (52 variables, reference values converted kPa/kJ to Pa/J by hand); for the liquid-line variant, the solution stored in Liquid_Pipe_Pressure_Drop.EES (TM-0309, 52 variables, converted by hand)
verification.notes: Gas: reference values converted kPa/kJ to Pa/J by hand; h_i/SP[2] 7.97e-2: EES-vs-CoolProp R717 enthalpy reference offset (differences unaffected); Pr 4.43e-2 and cp: stale procedure-local records of an older EES run; DELTAT_total 1.82e-3 (cp backend). Excluded: DELTAp_elbows/DELTAp_Tees (stale), SP[6] (dead). The native file equals the former _coolsolve variant to 5.7e-12 on 53 common variables. Liquid-line variant: excluded cp, DELTAp_elbows, DELTAp_Tees (stale), SP[6]; h_i/SP[2] 7.66e-1 = ASHRAE vs IIR offset (148144 J/kg), Pr 8.76e-3, f 2.81e-3 and Dp/DELTAp/DELTAp_total/Head_loss 1.98e-3 (R134a viscosity/density through Re_D); fitting counts reconstructed from the stored DpF.
